title: ShareDetail
description: GET /api/v1/shares/{id} (T-016, 03 §3.2) — the ingest pipeline's state for one shared post: status + derived history, the source post, the latest analysis run (extraction per the canonical extraction contract), the failure/review reason, and the places it published or parked.

status_history.description: Derived checkpoints (share_stage_metrics + created_at), oldest first, ending at the current status.

url.description: The canonical post URL. Always present — `source_posts.url` is NOT NULL; a manual caption-only share still gets a synthetic one.

author_handle.description: The crediting influencer's handle, null when the post has no linked influencer.

analysis.description: The latest analysis run. Null until one starts.

model.description: The model id the run used. Always present — `analysis_runs.model` is NOT NULL, set before the run is created.

extraction.description: The model's structured output — the canonical extraction contract. Null while a run is in flight, and on a run that failed before producing schema-valid output.

failure.description: Why the pipeline stopped or paused. Present for `failed` and for `review` (where `manual_fallback` is true and it explains what the user must resolve); null otherwise.

step.description: The last pipeline stage that ran, null when nothing was recorded.

can_publish_best_guess.description: True when an uncertain review can be published as-is without being located first (T-098).

place.description: The primary published pin — null until the share publishes. Back-compat single-place view of `places[0]`.

places.description: Every published pin, primary first — a multi-place post fans out to several. Empty until the share publishes.

pending_place_count.description: How many extracted venues are still parked for review (partial publish). Equals `pending_places.length`.

pending_places.description: The parked venues themselves, each with the candidate places it can be attached to (T-071). Owner-only surface.

sharePlace.description: A published pin: enough to drop/centre a marker without a second query.

index.description: The venue's position in the extraction's `places` array.
